source_recommendation.title: Create beta rollback drill runbook fixture

rehearsal_inputs.name: rollback_rehearsal_contract
rehearsal_inputs.purpose: Bind the existing rollback rehearsal evidence shape.

rehearsal_inputs.name: readiness_rollup_contract
rehearsal_inputs.purpose: Confirm the beta drill does not imply live mutation execution.

rehearsal_inputs.name: rollback_rehearsal_script
rehearsal_inputs.purpose: Provide the fixture-only dry-run evidence generator.

rollback_drill_phases.name: preflight
rollback_drill_phases.operator_action: Verify clean checkout, current main, and no active release or deploy operation.
rollback_drill_phases.expected_evidence: preflight status records clean repository and safety boundaries.

rollback_drill_phases.name: simulate_fault
rollback_drill_phases.operator_action: Use the fixture candidate to model a rollback-triggering beta fault without mutating a repository.
rollback_drill_phases.expected_evidence: fault injection note records fixture source and no live execution.

rollback_drill_phases.name: generate_rollback_rehearsal
rollback_drill_phases.operator_action: Run the existing rollback rehearsal script against the fixture candidate.
rollback_drill_phases.expected_evidence: rollback rehearsal JSON validates with status ready or blocks at the first failing check.

rollback_drill_phases.name: verify_observer_readback
rollback_drill_phases.operator_action: Compare Foundry evidence with Mission or Command readback before any real rollback action.
rollback_drill_phases.expected_evidence: readback agrees that this drill remains planning-only.

rollback_drill_phases.name: closure
rollback_drill_phases.operator_action: Record pass/fail gates, no-promotion status, and next operator action.
rollback_drill_phases.expected_evidence: closure summary preserves no promotion and RSI denial.
